description: Extract the design language of a reference screenshot: the flat `tokens` list (colors, spacing, radii, font sizes/weights, shadows) PLUS a structured `styleSystem` — palette split into neutrals vs accents, the base spacing unit, the type-size scale and its modular ratio, named radius and elevation scales. Use this to copy a UI's *style/aesthetic* onto new content. The values are measured deterministically; it deliberately does NOT name semantic color roles (primary/accent/surface) or classify mood — assign those yourself from the image. Pass `emit` to get paste-ready shadcn CSS variables or a Tailwind @theme block. Input is an image file path.

disable_ocr.description: Skip OCR text extraction. OCR runs by default and roughly doubles latency; disable it when you don't need text content or typography (note: type scale is then empty).

dpr.description: Device pixel ratio of the screenshot (pass 2 for a Retina/Mac capture). When set, spacing/font-size/radius values are returned in CSS pixels instead of raw image pixels. Auto-detected when omitted.

emit.description: Instead of the token list, emit the full style system as paste-ready output: 'shadcn' (CSS custom properties with role TODOs), 'tailwind' (@theme block), or 'json'.

image_path.description: Path (absolute, or relative to the server's launch directory) to the screenshot to analyze.

name: tokens
title: Extract design tokens + a reusable style system from a screenshot
